ref_text: THEY ARE BEYOND ALL OTHER WORKS THAT I KNOW EXISTING DEPENDENT FOR THEIR EFFECT ON LOW SUBDUED TONES THEIR FAVORITE CHOICE IN TIME OF DAY BEING EITHER DAWN OR TWILIGHT AND EVEN THEIR BRIGHTEST SUNSETS PRODUCED CHIEFLY OUT OF GRAY PAPER
text: They are beyond all other works that I know existing, dependent for their effect on low subdued tones, their favorite choice in time of day being either dawn or twilight, and even their brightest sunsets produce chiefly out of grey paper.
